title: Choose the homepage composition
question: The Dispatch Label world is fixed. Which layout should become the measured build contract?

options.label: Single dispatch sheet
options.thesis: Headline, destination, link options, and future result read as one coherent dispatch document.
options.viewport: A large headline anchors the upper left while the destination line and expanded options span the working sheet beneath it.
options.risk: The broad composition needs disciplined responsive reflow to avoid becoming a poster on small screens.

options.label: Manifest split
options.lineage: editorial cover beside a working manifest
options.thesis: The promise stays fixed on the left while the complete shortening task occupies the larger working pane.
options.viewport: A 42/58 split gives the form the larger right column and keeps all current advanced controls visible in one compact manifest.
options.risk: The permanent split is excellent on desktop but must stack carefully on narrow screens.

options.label: Perforated handoff
options.lineage: address band above a detachable receipt
options.thesis: The long destination crosses one decisive action line, with configuration and future output separated below the perforation.
options.viewport: A full-width URL band dominates; link options sit lower left and a blank result handoff zone waits lower right.
options.risk: The empty result zone is visually strong but may consume too much space before submission.
